approach: One helper decides where records are read from: the tip of refs/heads/athena/records when it exists and holds a records/ tree, else the working tree's records/ (pre-cutover fallback). Tree readers (Records::load, RecordSet::load, and everything built on them: status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, audit, introspection, watcher) get a "current" entry point that swaps the treeish for the branch tip. Filesystem readers (read_records, the walltime reader, the study site generator, backtest) get a root: a detached worktree of the branch at one fixed path in the repo state directory, created or fast-forwarded on demand. The branch keeps files at the same paths as before (records/jobs/...), so path logic in the readers is unchanged and only the root moves. Tests build a scratch repo, import records/ with the existing importer, and compare each reader's output on both sources.

decisions.choice: Define the worktree location once, as a constant name plus a function in athena-data (lib.rs, with repo_state_dir), and the ensure/refresh helper plus treeish resolver in athena-core store.rs; every reader calls them.
decisions.reason: Criterion 3 and the 'mechanism' default: one definition makes the rule structural. A test greps the workspace sources for stray join("records") readers.

rejected.option: Each reader computes its own path
Put the helper in a new crate
rejected.why: athena-data is a leaf and already owns paths; athena-core owns Git access.

decisions.choice: Branch is used only if its tip exists and has at least one entry under records/; otherwise fall back to the given treeish / working tree.
decisions.reason: Keeps every existing test (some create a branch holding only landings) unchanged, and implements the pre-cutover fallback; criterion 4.

rejected.option: Use the branch whenever the ref exists
rejected.why: Would turn readers empty in fixtures with a landings-only branch.

rejected.option: Fail when the branch is absent

decisions.choice: Keep Records::load(git, treeish) and RecordSet::load(git, treeish) as exact-tree readers; add Records::load_current(git, head) and RecordSet::load_current that resolve the source then call them. Switch live callers (status, review, run, manage, watcher, reading, hestia, code_health, auditor, audience, steward, work_decisions, introspect, drain) to the current form.
decisions.reason: Gate checks (reconcile, history) and tests deliberately load a historical commit's tree; those must stay exact.

rejected.why: Would break checks of main commits and historical-commit tests.

decisions.choice: Worktree is detached at the branch tip; refresh = git worktree add --detach when missing, else checkout --detach --force of the tip when HEAD differs; prune stale registrations first.
decisions.reason: Branch is append-only and checked out nowhere else; detached avoids git refusing a branch already checked out and never moves the ref.

rejected.why: Git blocks a second checkout and a checkout could be mistaken for a writer.

decisions.choice: Writers and admission.rs's 'records/ is Athena-only' path guard are left alone; admission.rs/records_import.rs change only to share the RECORDS_REF/path constants if needed.
decisions.reason: Out of scope: only readers move.

In store.rs add records_source (branch tip if it has records/, else the given treeish), ensure_records_worktree (create/refresh detached, locked), and Records::load_current; add RecordSet::load_current in gate records.rs.

risks.risk: Fixtures with a records branch holding only landings change reader results.
risks.mitigation: Branch used only when it has entries under records/; full cargo test run in the steps.

risks.risk: Stale worktree between runs, or concurrent refresh by two processes.
risks.mitigation: Refresh compares HEAD to the tip on every call; take a lock file in the state dir during add/checkout.

risks.risk: Large edit across ~35 call sites in a single run.
risks.mitigation: Mechanical rename to load_current; keep old load for historical trees; compile-driven.

risks.risk: Scratch tests without a state dir write into the user's real state.
risks.mitigation: Tests set ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir.

demonstrations.method: A new integration test in crates/athena-cli/tests (records_branch_readers.rs) builds a scratch repo with a records/ fixture holding jobs, outcomes, interventions, host errors, audits, scores and a walltime-eligible job.json, runs import_records at C0, then for each reader compares output from the pre-cutover source (no branch) with output after the branch exists and records/ is deleted from the tree: Records::load_current vs load, RecordSet::load_current, read_records(worktree) vs read_records(repo), the xtask walltime function, status text, forecast, scoring, retry carry, audit listing, introspection reads, and the site generator output. Asserts equal and non-empty.
demonstrations.observes: Every named reader yields identical, non-empty results from the branch worktree and from records/.
demonstrations.fails_without: If any reader still read the working tree, deleting records/ would make its output empty and differ; if the worktree were stale or wrong the compare fails.

demonstrations.method: Test runs the athena binary (as other tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/binary.rs do) with a state dir set, on a scratch checkout after import where the working tree's records/ is removed and committed away: runs `athena status` and a forecast command, requires exit 0 and stdout equal to the run on the checkout that still has records/.
demonstrations.observes: Both commands succeed with matching output with no records/ in the working tree.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the redirect, status/forecast see no records and output differs or errors.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in athena-data asserts the worktree path is repo_state_dir(...).join(constant) and ends with the one constant; a policy-style test in xtask/tests scans crates/*/src and xtask/src non-test code for reader joins of "records" / "records/jobs" outside the helper and an allow-list of the fallback and writers, failing on any other.
demonstrations.observes: One path definition; no reader outside the allow-list hard-codes records/.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader that joins root.join("records") directly trips the scan.

demonstrations.method: Run the full checks with no branch present; fallback keeps all existing tests passing.
demonstrations.observes: All pre-existing tests pass unchanged; also run cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check clean.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the fallback were missing, tests with no branch would read nothing and fail.

demonstrations.method: Content check by reading: a new D-entry in docs/decisions.md and an Unreleased line in CHANGELOG.md naming D111, the worktree, and the fallback; existing decisions/changelog tests and the boundary scan cover format.
demonstrations.observes: Policy tests on decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md pass; the entries mention D111 and the fallback (verifier reads with git diff).
